args.question: Acme Supplies (V-712) has two approved invoices, so I need you to confirm which one to pay before I send anything: INV-44255 for $7,468.88 (due 2026-11-04) or INV-50902 for $2,059.63 (due 2026-11-25). There is also a draft invoice, INV-53481 ($3,106.06), which is awaiting approval and which I have not touched. Once you tell me which approved invoice to pay, I'll send it by wire, or by ACH if wire is unavailable, paying the full amount once.
